races.paceDynamic: Pioneer Pete provides the only genuine pace angle with his confirmed front-running style and strong recent form, likely to dictate from the front without serious pressure early. The real tactical concern is the massive congestion behind him — Hashtag Queen, Prince Of Clova, Double Tiger, Emerald Time, Chico Magnifica, Collanisi, Asta La Vista, and Hellion all wanting prominent positions creates a traffic nightmare approaching the business end.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pioneer Pete Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete gets an uncontested lead and the prominent pack gets snarled up
scenarios.body: Pioneer Pete uses his front-running advantage while the field gets caught in traffic behind. The hold-up horses can't get through the congestion in time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Deliver
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes messy with prominent runners fighting for position
scenarios.body: The congestion allows patient riders on Our Guide, Finbarr, and King Esoteric to find cleaner routes late. These 120-rated hold-up horses sweep past the battling prominent brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the higher-rated prominent runners (Hashtag Queen/Chico Magnifica) avoids the traffic
scenarios.body: They get first run on the leaders while others are still fighting for room. Pioneer Pete's stamina gives way to a classier opponent with tactical position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete doesn't handle the going or gets headed too early
scenarios.body: The lack of other natural leaders creates a stop-start affair that becomes a sprint. The hold-up horses with finishing kicks benefit from the tactical mess.

watchPoints.text: Pioneer Pete's jumping under pressure — if he makes an error when challenged, the race dynamics completely change
Traffic problems approaching two out where 8 prominent runners converge — several good chances could get shuffled back
Our Guide's position tracking — needs to be handy enough to capitalize when the pace kicks but not get caught in early scrimmaging
How quickly the prominent runners commit — if they go too hard too early, it opens the door for the hold-up brigade
Ground conditions during the race — any deterioration could favor the stronger staying types over the speed horses

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the 5 prominent runners interfere with each other approaching 3 out creating a bunched finish.
scenarios.body: The pace collapses into a cavalry charge where positioning becomes critical and the strongest stayer prevails. Hold-up horses struggle to find racing room in the melee.

scenarios.body: Mixedwave or The Clonmel Kid escapes the traffic and gets a crucial jump on the field turning for home. They maintain the advantage as the hold-up horses chase too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Masterclass
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys recognize the pace trap and several prominent runners drop back early.
scenarios.body: The race becomes truly-run with genuine pace and the best horse on ratings can assert their superiority. Holeshot's class advantage becomes decisive in a properly-run contest.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe interference 3 out when Giovanni Change, Mixedwave, Holeshot, The Clonmel Kid, and The Great Escape all converge seeking the same racing position.
Monitor whether Cardamon Hill can secure a clear passage given the expected bunching - his hold-up style needs racing room to be effective.
Check if any prominent horse drops back early to avoid the traffic - this tactical switch could prove decisive.
Observe whether Slaney Opera can reproduce his Kempton form with the step up in grade against stronger opposition.
Watch for Holeshot being caught in the prominent scrum despite being top-rated - his style preference may work against him.

races.paceDynamic: Ionian, King Of The Road, and Jhentong Enki will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with 9 prominent runners creating serious congestion turning for home. The extended trip combined with genuine pace will test stamina reserves, favoring those who can settle and finish strongly rather than those dependent on tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Holds Up
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners maintain their gallop and don't collapse
scenarios.body: The genuine pace stretches the field and eliminates the weaker stayers, allowing the best horses to emerge late. Hold-up horses with proven stamina come through the tiring leaders to contest the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Late
scenarios.trigger: If the 9 prominent runners create interference turning in
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get blocked or hampered when the pace quickens, allowing those with clear runs to capitalize. The race becomes as much about luck in running as ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Ionian, King Of The Road and Jhentong Enki all fade by halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with minimal stamina test, suiting those with tactical pace rather than true stayers. The prominent runners who conserved energy early prove strongest late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders kicks clear 3 out and stays on
scenarios.body: Either Jhentong Enki or King Of The Road uses their early position to build an unassailable lead when rivals tire. The chasing pack cannot organize an effective pursuit on the testing ground.

watchPoints.text: Bras d'Or and Keno Black both show concerning going profiles with recent heavy ground form failing to translate to good conditions.

Jhentong Enki's recent winning form makes him key pace angle - if he leads and stays strong others must work harder.
Hold-up quartet of Duel Au Soleil, Miss Cynthia, Just Call Me Lucy and Forest Blaze could dominate if pace scenario unfolds as expected.

scenarios.trigger: If Thank You Ma'am maintains an honest but manageable gallop throughout

scenarios.trigger: If the good going rides worse than expected during the race

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops

The lack of early pace pressure could result in a sprint finish that favors the prominent runners over the hold-up horses.

races.paceDynamic: Jonquilla and Steady The Ship will dispute the early lead, with Jonquilla's higher rating making her the likely pace-setter through the early stages. With most of the field adopting hold-up tactics, this creates a stark division between two confirmed front-runners and thirteen patient types, setting up a tactical battle where the early leaders face sustained pressure from multiple late challengers. The honest gallop should suit those who can quicken from prominent positions like Jeteye and Rebel Intentions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If Jonquilla and Steady The Ship go too fast early and tire dramatically
scenarios.body: The pace duel burns out both leaders as the hold-up brigade closes en masse. Multiple horses with strong finishing kicks converge, favoring those with best recent form and ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Jonquilla controls throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Jonquilla can dictate a sensible pace without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: She uses her class advantage to string out the field and resist the late challenge. Steady The Ship's lesser rating means she cannot sustain serious pressure, leaving Jonquilla to fend off late closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent horses profit
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but not destructive, suiting those tracking closely
scenarios.body: Jeteye and Rebel Intentions get perfect stalking positions behind the leaders and have enough in reserve to quicken. The hold-up horses find too much to do against the solid gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse steals it
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes messy or slow, playing into patient tactics
scenarios.body: The front-runners go too slowly or one drops out early, creating a sprint finish. A well-handicapped hold-up horse with good going form gets the perfect setup.

watchPoints.text: Jonquilla's jumping under early pressure — any mistake while dueling with Steady The Ship could end her chances immediately
How quickly Steady The Ship drops away once Jonquilla asserts — her fadeout timing will determine how many hold-up horses get into contention
Jeteye's position tracking the leaders through the early stages — needs to avoid getting too far back to utilize his strong finishing kick
The gap between front two and the main pack at halfway — if it gets beyond ten lengths the hold-up horses face impossible task
Which hold-up horses are traveling best turning for home — Bodygroove and Getaway Glory have the form to capitalize if pace collapses
